title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: US futures subdued as higher oil prices curb risk appetite after S&P 500’s record close - The Economic Times
text:
Dow Jones Today | US Stock Market Live: Cooling rate-hike expectations ⁠and resilient ⁠corporate earnings have put the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq on track for a third straight week of ​gains, their longest winning streak since early April.

US stock futures were muted on Friday as rising crude prices following the latest Middle East developments kept investors cautious, a day after the S&P 500 closed at a record high.

At 6:07 a.m. ET, Dow E-minis fell 64 points, or 0.12%, while S&P 500 E-minis gained 5.75 points, or 0.07%. Nasdaq 100 E-minis rose 54.25 points, or 0.18%.
